messages:
Alex Nguyen: Quick heads-up — I need to swap primary for the 23:00->07:00 window tonight. Flight delay, so I’m taking the handoff early at 22:45. Leaving the most-recent notes below. @Priya @Jamie can you shadow? I’ll keep pager on.

Incident Bot: [AUTOMATED] 2026-03-15T19:14:02Z — embedding-rate-exceeded in us-west-2 (INC-4512). Pager routed to eng-oncall. Current symptom: increased 429s from embed service, pref.kv-cache misses high.

Priya Kapoor: Copy. Are we seeing warm pool exhaustion or just encoder throttles?

Alex Nguyen: Looks like encoder throttles + a simultaneous spike in very long batch requests. Per telemetry, avg seq_len jumped from ~256 -> ~1024 for a subset of customers. That pushed continuous-batcher queues to latency SLO and triggered rate-limiter.

Jamie O'Connor: I can shadow as secondary. Quick mitigation checklist?

Alex Nguyen: Short list I did before I leave: 
- Move affected customers to fallback model-quant (lower mem, faster) via routing policy.
- Temporarily bump dedicated pool from 8->12 replicas in us-west-2.
- Enable prefix-KV cache for top 5 customers with repeat queries.
- Throttle long-seq requests at the ingress (cut seq_len > 2048 or rate-limit per-client).

Priya Kapoor: If we scale pool, we should also update autoscaler dampening so it doesn't immediately downscale at 5m. Set floor at 10 for next 2h.

Sam Lee: I’ll take the dashboard/alerts watch and message any regression. Putting a brief note in the SRE runbook channel.

Alex Nguyen: Runbook snippet I used (paste):
```
# quick mitigation commands (k8s and routing)
kubectl scale deployment/redwood-embed-usw2 -n inference --replicas=12
curl -X POST https://routing.internal/api/v1/route_override \
  -d '{"prefix":"customer:top5","model":"embed-small-v1","duration":"2h"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN'

# to enable prefix caching for customer ids
infra-tool cache enable --region=us-west-2 --customers cust123,cust456 --ttl=300
```

Jamie O'Connor: Thanks — that helps. I can run the route override if you can hand me the token or create a short-lived one.

Alex Nguyen: Giving you a one-off: token=redact-xxxx (DMed). Also note: if paging noise persists, flip routing preference to eu-west-1 for non-PII customers. That buys us headroom.

Incident Bot: [NOTIFICATION] Escalation policy: if pager hits 3x in 30m escalate to eng-sre. Current pager count: 1.

Priya Kapoor: Confirmed I'll change autoscaler floor to 10 and hold for 2h. Also adding a throttling rule at the edge: `edge-config set rate_limit seq_len:>2048 2/min` — this should kill the pathological long batches.

Sam Lee: I'll open a short customer-impact note for ops-customer-comm: "Possible transient embed degradation for a small number of customers in us-west-2. Mitigations in progress." Ping me edits.

Alex Nguyen: Active incident summary to leave in handoff: INC-4512, root cause suspected: customer workload shift + long-seq pathological requests. Current mitigations applied: scaled USW2 pool -> 12, route_override for top5 to embed-small-v1, prefix-KV cache enabled for top5, edge throttle for seq_len > 2048. Secondary Jamie O'Connor is shadowing; Sam is monitoring dashboards.

Jamie O'Connor: I've applied the route override and confirmed 200 from routing API. Also validated extra pods are scheduling; two are still pending (node provisioning), ETA ~4m.

Priya Kapoor: Autoscaler floor set. I left a retention tag on the pods so they won't be reclaimed immediately.

Sam Lee: Dashboard shows p95 latency trending down after route override. Still seeing some 429s but dropping. Logging suggests a particular customer (cust123) sent 6x normal traffic. I’ll DM support to coordinate a quick rate-limiting heads-up.

Alex Nguyen: Perfect. Handing off formally: I’m reachable by phone but will be offline for boarding from 22:05–22:35. After that I’ll check in until 23:15 while I seat. Primary responsibilities pass to Jamie at 22:45. Jamie — you’re primary; Priya remains secondary for escalation. Leave notes in INC-4512. :thumbsup:

Oncall Rotations: [SYSTEM] Primary rotation updated: Jamie O'Connor -> primary 2026-03-15T22:45:00Z to 2026-03-16T07:00:00Z; Alex Nguyen -> off duty. Secondary remains Priya Kapoor.

Jamie O'Connor: Got it. Taking primary at 22:45. I’ll monitor embed pager and call for eng-sre if we see another spike.

Alex Nguyen: Thanks team — leaving the last three checks here: 1) confirm pending nodes come up, 2) confirm cache hit rate >60% for top5, 3) watch for new long-seq clients showing up. Back tomorrow morning for postmortem if needed.

Priya Kapoor: Noted. Will keep autoscaler sticky for 2 hours.

Sam Lee: I’ll update customer ops and keep a short blameless note in INC-4512 once stable.

Jamie O'Connor: All set. Safe travels Alex. :airplane:
